text: dsh-reminder 是面向 DSH Web 的桌面提醒插件：它订阅会话列表与当前对话快照，在任务回合完成或操作等待审批时显示浏览器通知。通知包含会话标题、工具名或耗时，点击可回到对应会话；可在设置页开关两类提醒、调整停留时间并检查通知权限。适合需要切换窗口处理其他工作的 DSH 用户；需要浏览器通知权限，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-reminder adds desktop reminders to DSH web. It watches sessions and notifies when a turn completes or approval is needed, showing the session or tool. Clicking opens the session. Settings control reminder types and duration. Browser notification permission is required; no API key is needed.
切到别的窗口后，我想知道 DSH 任务什么时候跑完。
DSH 有操作等我审批时能不能弹桌面通知？
我想点一下通知就回到对应的会话。
能提醒我某个后台会话从运行状态变成完成吗？
我想关掉审批提醒，但保留任务完成提醒。
浏览器通知权限在哪里开启并确认有效？
How can I get a desktop alert when a DSH turn finishes while I am in another app?
Can a notification take me straight back to the session that needs approval?
I want to check browser notification permission and send a test alert.
How do I turn off approval popups but keep completion alerts?
dsh-reminder 的功能「回合完成通知」：检测当前对话出现新的成功结束回合，显示任务完成通知与会话标题；若有计时数据，也显示耗时，点击通知可打开会话。
dsh-reminder 的功能「待审批通知」：会话列表出现审批等待时，显示等待许可通知和工具名称；按会话与审批 ID 去重，点击后聚焦 DSH 并打开该会话。
dsh-reminder 的功能「后台会话完成兜底」：后台会话完成标志变化或运行状态转为空闲时发送完成通知，避免依赖单一完成信号；首次观察只建立基线。
dsh-reminder 的功能「提醒设置」：设置面板可分别启停审批与完成提醒、调整通知停留时间，并展示浏览器权限状态；设置通过宿主 Remote 保存。
dsh-reminder 的功能「通知权限测试」：用户可从设置页发起浏览器授权请求；授权成功后立即发送测试通知，帮助确认桌面通知通道可用。
dsh-reminder 使用前须知：浏览器未支持 Notification API 或通知权限未获准时，提醒不会弹出；可在设置页查看权限并发出测试通知。

dsh-reminder README · dsh-reminder 🔔：

English · 简体中文

**A cross-window reminder plugin for DeepSeek Harness** — while you work in any other window, it taps you on the shoulder the moment a task **finishes** or **waits for your approval**. Codex / WorkBuddy style. ---

dsh-reminder README · ✨ Features：| 🎯 | Feature | Description |
|---|---------|-------------|
| 🟢 | Completion | Pops "Task completed" on every turn end, with session · duration and a green check icon |
| 🟡 | Approval | Pops "Waiting for your approval" with the tool name and an amber alert icon |
| 🎯 | Pops in any window | Notifies even while you work in other apps |
| 🖱️ | Click to return | Clicking focuses the DSH window and opens the session |
| ⏱️ | Auto-dismiss | Gone in 3-5 s (adjustable) |
| 🎵 | Soft chime | A gentle two-note chime (D4→A4) — nothing startling |
| 🔁 | Deduplicated | Never pops twice for the same event |
| 🛡️ | Reminds, never acts | Never approves on your behalf |

dsh-reminder README · 🤔 Why：- 😴 *Nobody calls you for approvals* — the agent waits while you are away; now an amber popup tells you
- 👀 *Nobody tells you it's done* — no completion signal before; now a green popup tells you

---

dsh-reminder README · 🚀 Quick start：1. **Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add <dsh-reminder>` (or `npm i dsh-reminder`), register `dsh-reminder` in the profile bundle list, restart the DSH web process
2. **Grant permission**: Settings → Reminders → "Enable & test notifications" → Allow — a test popup arrives instantly
3. **Enjoy**: Switch away and work — the popups come to you

---

dsh-reminder README · ⚙️ Settings：| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Notification permission | unset | One-click grant + test popup |
| Approval reminders | On | Off = no approval popups |
| Completion reminders | On | Off = no completion popups |
| Duration | 3-5 s | Seconds before auto-dismiss |
| Failure alerts | Off (reserved) | Planned for v0.3 |

---

dsh-reminder README · 🏗️ Architecture：One package ships the **host Cordis plugin** and the **web client**:

- **host**: registers the settings namespace plus a plugin-owned Typert Remote (`reminder/getSettings` · `updateSettings`) — plugin namespaces sit outside the web settings allowlist
- **client**: subscribes to the session list and conversation snapshots (turn/end, approval/requested arrive over the mux stream), pops via the Notification API with a Web Audio chime
- **Read-only**: never mutates DSH core behavior

dsh-reminder README · 🔧 Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test            # node tests/unit/*.test.cjs (16 tests)
pnpm run build       # esbuild: host ESM + single-file client CJS (ModuleLoader handshake) + tsc d.ts

- Artifacts: `lib/index.js` (host ESM), `lib/client.js` (client), `lib/types/` (.d.ts)
- Offline dev: no new dependencies; @deepseek-ai/* types and local esbuild/typescript come from `03_local/codes` (not in git)

dsh-reminder README · ⚠️ Known limits：- Chrome page notifications reject `actions` (ServiceWorker persistent notifications only) — dismiss via auto-close or the hover ✕
- Permission must be requested from a user gesture (browser policy) — the settings button does it in one click
- The chime unlocks on the first click (autoplay policy)
